exposure: continuous oxytocin administration (2 IU/h until 24 hours after delivery)
cohort: 156 women with twin pregnancies who underwent cesarean delivery.
finding: Continuous oxytocin administration after cesarean delivery for twin pregnancies significantly reduced the mean amount of lochia, reduction in Hb/Ht levels, and the incidence of lochia exceeding 500g or 1000g, suggesting a reduction in postpartum hemorrhage.
